questions.solution:
A monk works in a monastery. An author creates a book. A painter works in a gallery.

All the other pairs involve either a person and their workplace or a person and the product/output of their work. But, a restaurant is a place used by a chef and not by recipe.

Spectacles is used for reading. Broom is used for Sweeping. Oven is used for Baking.

But, Needle is used for Sewing.

Running, Cycling and Hiking are aerobic cardiovascular exercises that involve continuous movement and increased heart rate.

Yoga focuses more on flexibility, breathing, and static poses and not cardio.
Sudoku, Chess and Crossword are mental activity games while football is a physical sport, requiring physical agility, strength, and movement.

Fast is the synonym of Quick.

Angry is the synonym of Furious.

Stare is the synonym of Look.

But, Speedy is the antonym of Delay.

A blueprint is the plan created by an architect.

A manuscript is the initial form of writing created by an author

A recipe is the guide created by cook.

Sonography is a process/tool used by a radiologist, not by a Cardiologist.

A seed naturally grows into a plant. An egg hatches into a chick. A larva transforms into a butterfly. A goat does not naturally become leather; leather is produced from goat skin through human processing.
Trunk, branches, and bark are parts of the above-ground structure of a tree. Roots are the only underground part.

Barren is the antonym of Fertile.

Coarse is the antonym of Refined.

Radiant is the antonym of Dull.

But, Help is the synonym of support.

Robust is the antonym of Weak.

Intricate is the antonym of Simple.

Brittle is the antonym of Flexible.

But, Tiny is the synonym of Miniature.

questions.solution:
Salt is fortified with iodine to prevent deficiency.

Milk is naturally rich in calcium.

Kiwi is a natural source of vitamin C.

But Fish is the rich source of Omega-3 fatty acid and not sugar.

Science is a subject.

Oscillation is a motion.

Hydrogen is a gas.

But, Umbrella is used in rain.

Cease is the synonym of Stop.

Crave is the synonym of Desire.

Elegant is the synonym of Beautiful.

But, Prestigious is the antonym of Ordinary.

Function is the synonym of Role.

Issue is the synonym of Matter.

Maintain is the synonym of Sustain.

But, Stabilize is the antonym of Vary.

questions.solution:
Voltmeter is used for measuring electric voltage.

Seismograph is used for detecting earthquake.

Hygrometer is used for measuring humidity.

But Compass is used for detecting direction and not time.

Fan is used for cooling. Window is used for Ventilation. Wheel is used for movement.

But fork is used for eating/picking food and not for peeling.

A calculator is used for performing calculations. A mirror is used to reflect images. A lock is used for security purposes. A helmet is not used for heat, but is worn for safety while using a vehicle.

Anthill, Nest, and Web are constructed or built by animals.

A cave is a naturally occurring shelter that used by animals but not built by animals.

Mitochondria, Nucleus, and Ribosomes are organelles inside cells, found in both plant and animal cells.

Stomata are structures on the surface of plant leaves, not internal organelles.
